title: EmailSubmissionFilterCondition has zero tests
description: EmailSubmissionFilterCondition (submission.rs lines 281-316) has no test module. EmailFilterCondition has 10+ tests. Minimum needed: (1) round-trip with all fields set, (2) empty condition serializes to {}, (3) use inside Filter<EmailSubmissionFilterCondition> with OR operator, (4) before/after UTCDate fields, (5) undoStatus field with known UndoStatus value.
